finding: compound: classification helps over BC/nearest (template 0.1 vs nearest 0.033 vs random 0.033, BC 0.0), BUT best open-loop distillation 0.1 reaches only 0.19× per-state expert 0.533 → knife-edge state-specific θ basins (robust_k6 0.235) dominate; open-loop distillation blocked, option advantage needs per-state search or its cheap amortization
safe_claims: The structured option space is valid.
Per-state search extracts strong performance from it (0.533 K6).
Simple one-shot amortization retains only a small fraction (~0.19x) of that performance.
not_proven: It is NOT proven that no parametric actor can learn theta(s). Only proven insufficient: global single theta, nearest-neighbour retrieval, coarse template classification, random bank pick, deterministic MSE regression.
open_mechanisms: multimodality (several distant theta succeed; single-vector regression averages)
fine state-dependence not locally smooth in the current feature space
too little / poorly covered data (classifier saw only sparse modes)
knife-edge execution (good theta shatters under small error; robust_k6 0.235)
templates too coarse (classification finds the mode but the within-mode residual is missing)
